```typescript
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const input = await req.json();
  
  const threadId = input.threadId ?? 
    (await openai.beta.threads.create({
      tool_resources: {
        file_search: {
          vector_store_ids: ["vs_meWOEnUiUxtQWf0W6NBsNpCG"],
        },
      },
    })).id;
    
  const createdMessage = await openai.beta.threads.messages.create(threadId, {
    role: "user",
    content: input.message,
  });

  return AssistantResponse(
    { threadId, messageId: createdMessage.id },
    async ({ forwardStream, sendDataMessage }) => {
      const runStream = openai.beta.threads.runs.stream(
        threadId,
        {
          tools: [
            {
              type: "file_search",
            },
            {
              type: "function",
              function: {
                name: "file_search_and_transform",
                description: "Performs a file search, hands off results to searchDatabase, and transforms the results into nodes and edges",
                parameters: {
                  type: "object",
                  required: [
                    "user_query",
                    "data_shape",
                    "connection_description"
                  ],
                  properties: {
                    user_query": {
                      type: "string",
                      description: "The query input by the user for the file search"
                    },
                    "data_shape": {
                      type: "object",
                      description: "General shape of the data response from the file search",
                      properties: {
                        "fields": {
                          type: "array",
                          description: "List of fields in the data response",
                          items: {
                            type: "string",
                            description: "Field name in the response"
                          }
                        },
                        "record_count": {
                          type: "number",
                          description: "Number of records returned from the file search"
                        }
                      },
                      additionalProperties: false,
                      required: [
                        "fields",
                        "record_count"
                      ]
                    },
                    "connection_description": {
                      type: "string",
                      description: "Description of the connections among the records returned"
                    }
                  },
                  additionalProperties: false
                }
              }
            }
          ],
          additional_instructions: NER_EXTRACTION_PROMPT,
          assistant_id: DISCLOSURE_ASSISTANT_ID ?? 
            (() => { throw new Error("ASSISTANT_ID environment is not set"); })(),
        },
        assistantEventHandler
      );

      let runResult = await forwardStream(runStream);

      while (
        runResult?.status === "requires_action" &&
        runResult.required_action?.type === "submit_tool_outputs"
      ) {
        const tool_outputs = await Promise.all(
          runResult.required_action.submit_tool_outputs.tool_calls.map(
            async (toolCall) => {
              const parameters = JSON.parse(toolCall.function.arguments);

              if (toolCall.function.name === "file_search_and_transform") {
                // Extract parameters
                const { user_query, data_shape, connection_description } = parameters;
                
                // Perform file search
                // (This would integrate with your existing search functionality)
                
                // Process and transform the data
                const flowData = await xataToXYFlow({
                  question: user_query,
                  table: data_shape.fields[0] || "default_table", // Use appropriate table selection logic
                  context: input.message,
                });
                
                // Send visualization data
                await sendDataMessage({
                  type: "xyflow_visualization",
                  description: "Graph visualization data",
                  data: flowData,
                });
                
                return {
                  tool_call_id: toolCall.id,
                  output: JSON.stringify({
                    success: true,
                    nodesCount: flowData.nodes.length,
                    edgesCount: flowData.edges.length,
                    data_shape: data_shape,
                    connection_summary: connection_description
                  }),
                };
              }
              
              throw new Error(`Unknown tool call function: ${toolCall.function.name}`);
            }
          )
        );
        
        runResult = await forwardStream(
          openai.beta.threads.runs.submitToolOutputsStream(
            threadId,
            runResult.id,
            { tool_outputs }
          )
        );
      }
      
      return runResult;
    }
  );
}
```
